evals.name: Clean Architecture Boundary & Repository Token Binding
evals.prompt: Scaffold a NestJS feature module using abstract repository interfaces and Symbol tokens to decouple the service from concrete ORMs.
evals.expected_output: Defines IFeatureRepository interface with Symbol token FEATURE_REPOSITORY, bound to concrete repository in Module providers and injected via @Inject(FEATURE_REPOSITORY).
assertions: Defines abstract repository interface and Symbol injection token
Binds repository interface token in feature module providers
Injects repository token in domain service via @Inject decorator
Prevents direct database ORM calls inside HTTP controllers

evals.name: DTO Validation & OpenAPI Schema Inheritance
evals.prompt: Create validated DTOs for a NestJS feature using class-validator and PartialType from @nestjs/swagger for updates.
evals.expected_output: Creates CreateFeatureDto with @IsString, @IsNotEmpty, @ApiProperty and UpdateFeatureDto extending PartialType(CreateFeatureDto).
assertions: Applies class-validator decorators to all request payload DTO fields
Extends CreateFeatureDto using PartialType for update payloads
Annotates controller endpoints with Swagger @ApiTags and @ApiOperation
Enforces strict typing with zero explicit any annotations

evals.name: Isolated Unit Testing with Mocked Repositories
evals.prompt: Write isolated unit tests for a NestJS feature service using Test.createTestingModule and mocked repository methods.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds service unit test spec injecting mocked repository provider and asserting create and findOne business logic.
assertions: Configures unit testing module using Test.createTestingModule
Provides mock repository implementation using jest.fn methods
Tests domain exceptions including NotFoundException on missing records
Clears mock states in beforeEach hook
